title: On the Shelf or in the Wardrobe?

sections.title: Surface vs. container
sections.content: szekrény ("wardrobe, cupboard") is a container, not a surface — clothes go inside it, so it takes -ban/-ben ("in") like szoba or konyha, not -on/-en/-ön. Ask yourself: is it resting ON top, or closed away INSIDE?

items.english: The clothes are in the wardrobe.

items.spanish: Sok bútor van az új lakásunkban.
items.english: There's a lot of furniture in our new apartment.

sections.content: A polc holds books ON its surface, but a szekrény keeps clothes IN it — that's the whole decision. When in doubt, picture the object: is it sitting on top, or shut inside?
